style: 3D animated satire, deadpan slapstick; penguin fills two thirds of frame height

subject.character: ONE neat emperor penguin accountant, black tailcoat, bow tie, orange beak; same face throughout, fully serious

props.jars_crate: plain glass jars, screw lids; plain wooden crate; no labels
props.leaflets: white leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic capitals

environment: small ice floe, dense pressure ridges with icicles, deep blue water
lighting: low polar sun behind-left, gold glints; cold blue sky glow behind-right; flares on every move

light_events.event: rotor shadows strobe across the floe

motion_rule: the camera orbits them every beat, new shot size every beat, never parked; he moves his whole body every beat; the walrus acts every beat

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once inside its beat, no pause after Я; after 4.75 rotor roar, gasps, glass clinks, no words

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left; he belly-slides in along the ridge; the walrus yanks a jar from the crate
waist shot, orbit right; still sliding, he brakes with his flippers, springs up, breath puffs; the walrus unscrews the jar with a tusk
medium, orbit left; he trips on flat ice, flails, waddles on; the walrus slaps the ice, spray flies, jar under flipper
medium, counter-arc; he waddles round the walrus, fixing his bow tie; the walrus swivels after him, jar under flipper
waist shot, orbit; he hops sideways along the crate, slaps his chest, breath puffs; behind him the walrus scoops the puff into the jar, lid shut
medium, arc; he spins on his heel, waddles along the edge in profile, flipper up; the walrus flings the jar into the crate, slams the lid
low medium, swift orbit; helicopter skids drop to top frame edge, spray bursts; he is knocked flat, belly-slides in a circle; the walrus digs tusks into the ice
waist shot, arc, leaflets pour from the helicopter; he springs up, a leaflet slaps his face, he spins, peels it off; one sticks to the walrus's tusks
waist shot, orbit; he reads it backing away, gasps silently, beak wide, topples sideways; the walrus knocks the lid off, snatches a clean jar
medium, orbit; the walrus leaps and claps the jar over the gasping beak, the jar fogs; he kicks, spins on one foot, hops
waist shot, orbit; jar on beak, he waddles a half circle, turns to camera; the walrus clinks the jar with a tusk, slaps a leaflet on the crate
medium, orbit left; jar on beak, he waddles a wide arc; the walrus lumbers after him; leaflets settle
low medium, orbit right; he flops on his belly, slides in a curve; the walrus slaps a leaflet on his back
waist shot, orbit; he springs up, hops, jar on beak; the walrus clinks it; leaflets drift down

must_appear: 0.00 penguin belly-slides in; 4.75 rotor shadows, skids at top edge, spray; 5.45 leaflets ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ; 6.70 walrus claps a jar over the gasping beak
negative_prompt: static camera, locked-off shots, subtitles, watermark, jar labels, digits, duplicate penguins, two walruses, duplicate props, floating jars, hero walking away from camera, his back to camera, top-down wide shot, a jar held up to the lens, a repeated word, speech after 4.9, a spoken word on the leaflets, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs
